mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_activity_day (user_id, activity_date, accepted_count, new_solved_problem_count, create_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{activityDate}, 1, #{newSolvedProblemIncrement}, 'system') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE accepted_count = accepted_count + 1, new_solved_problem_count = new_solved_problem_count + #{newSolvedProblemIncrement}, update_by = 'system', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
